x-summary: Proficiency in a language on the STANAG 6001 scale, 0 to 5.
title: LanguageProficiency
description: STANAG 6001-flavored language proficiency record. The 0-5 Standardized Language Profile (SLP) scale across four skills is widely known public information, but the detailed level descriptors are NOT verified against the primary standard here. Field-checked against FHIR's Patient.communication backbone element — that element is much thinner (just a coded language + a preferred flag), which only confirms STANAG's 4-skill/0-5-scale granularity is a genuine, deliberate addition beyond what FHIR itself models, not an oversight.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code picked from IHDS (x-reference). Older free-text values stay valid and are shown as written.

listening.x-help: STANAG 6001 level: 0 none, 1 survival, 2 functional, 3 professional, 4 expert, 5 native.

preferred.x-help: The language the person prefers to be addressed in.
preferred.description: FHIR Patient.communication.preferred (real field) — whether this is the person's preferred language among however many language_proficiency records they have.
